dimension_assessments.summary: Cross-document references exist, but caller, consumer, propagation, and seam-verification contracts are absent.
Lifecycle and partial-attachment concepts lack a closed state and transition model.
Session reuse identity is present without attach serialization, epochs, ordering, stale-response, or cancellation rules.
The plan forbids fabricated health during partial attachment, but does not define the state derivation and per-capability consequences of partial failure.
Server lifecycle and provisioning have no restart, cleanup, reattachment, rollback, or failed-upgrade contract.
Product ownership, external-reference status, and remote-root authority are explicit non-gaps, but execution, installation, download, and policy authority are not assigned.
Diagnostics enter storage and LLM-facing contexts without retention, redaction, consent, deletion, or transmission rules.
Custom commands, environment values, initialization options, downloads, and license files have no trust-root or validation contract.
Capability overclaiming is explicitly forbidden, but the missing lifecycle state machine leaves starting, stale, retrying, and partially attached presentation semantics unresolved.
SSH placement and downloads have no disconnect, reconnect, interruption, expiry, queueing, or user-visible offline behavior.
Broad catalog and truncation concepts lack enforceable limits, ordering, disclosure, and resource-budget behavior.
User-visible state and diagnostics surfaces have no assistive-technology or keyboard interaction acceptance criteria.
User-visible LSP state and diagnostic identity have no localization, expansion, formatting, or bidirectional-layout contract.
Persisted vocabulary and protocol metadata are named without schema versioning, migration, downgrade, or negotiation-failure behavior.
Selection and lifecycle decisions lack structured reasons, correlation, metrics, bounded logs, and support-export semantics.
Server download and installation have no consent, atomicity, cancellation, cleanup, uninstall, or rollback safeguards.
ContractRefs preserve owner names, but dependency edges, seam payloads, propagation, and cross-owner acceptance remain undefined.
Migration and index checks cannot falsify the required runtime, failure, security, privacy, or GUI behavior.
The actual server shipping and legal matrix is not present in this blind window, and policy forbids consulting another source to determine closure.
